title: Ontology Series, Part IV: Governance, Maintenance, and AI
author: Jessica Talisman
local_file_name: Ontology Series, Part IV - Governance, Maintenance, and AI (mislabeled as PKM Part V).htm
thesis: Deployed models drift away from the organizations they describe; named stewardship and authority, semantic versioning, change requests tied to competency questions and regular review keep a model coherent, while AI proposes and people decide.
name: Ontology Series, Part IV: Governance, Maintenance, and AI

title: Process Knowledge Management, Part I: Accounting for How We Work
author: Jessica Talisman
local_file_name: Intentional Arrangement - Process Knowledge Management, Part I.pdf
thesis: Process knowledge, much of it tacit, is a distinct kind of organizational knowledge and now decides whether AI succeeds; representing it explicitly in ontologies with provenance makes AI more capable, interpretable and auditable.
name: Process Knowledge Management, Part I: Accounting for How We Work

title: Process Knowledge Management, Part II: Collection Development and Organizing Principles
author: Jessica Talisman
local_file_name: Intentional Arrangement - Process Knowledge Management, Part II.pdf
thesis: Managing process knowledge is three continuous activities: collecting it from practitioners and systems, organizing it under explicit principles and vocabularies, and encoding it for people, search and AI agents, sustained by curation, governance and feedback loops until the knowledge is adequate.
name: Process Knowledge Management, Part II: Collection Development and Organizing Principles

title: Process Knowledge Management, Part III: How We Lost Our Way
author: Jessica Talisman
local_file_name: Intentional Arrangement - Process Knowledge Management, Part III.pdf
thesis: Outsourcing shipped away the feedback loops, communities of practice and apprenticeship that generate process knowledge; organizations must audit what they hold, rebuild capture and transfer, and design new systems so knowledge capture is a primary goal.
name: Process Knowledge Management, Part III: How We Lost Our Way

title: Process Knowledge Management, Part IV: From Theory to Practice, The Procedural Knowledge Ontology
author: Jessica Talisman
local_file_name: Intentional Arrangement - Process Knowledge Management, Part IV.pdf
thesis: The Procedural Knowledge Ontology separates procedures from their executions, reuses established vocabularies, is built by a lightweight methodology from expert workshops, and grounds elicitation tools and AI assistants in governed procedural knowledge.
name: Process Knowledge Management, Part IV: From Theory to Practice, The Procedural Knowledge Ontology
